reviews.title: Better than “traditional” Hypnobirthing apps
reviews.contents:
I have used this app since finding (early on) that I was pregnant. 

The tracks and scriptures etc helped me through hyperemesis, insomnia, and other complications in my pregnancy. I am currently 37+3 weeks and I feel both prepared and ‘ready’ for baby now. 

This app will forever be my favourite birth preparation app, and I can’t wait to use it during the big day. I found it much more useful and relatable to traditional Hypnobirthing apps. Having a heart arrhythmia, breathing techniques and focus on up/down breathing stresses me out and draws attention to the irregularity of my heart - this app has helped me fully relax and zone out, whilst being in tune with God and my body at the same time! I have recommended it to a lot of people and will continue to do so after birth.

reviews.title: Loved it!
reviews.contents: I’ve really enjoyed this course and not only because it’s helped me feel more prepared for birth but also because it stays fixed on God and his design for birth. I’ve always been a bit unsure about hypnobirthing but a friend did this and recommended it to me. I love the opportunity to pray over the baby and also work through any trauma. I’ve not had my baby yet but look forward to using the techniques for here.  There’s so much more to it than just the hypnobirthing as there’s so much extra information that you don’t get at all the antenatal classes, I really valued this. I also found they were always super quick to respond to any questions etc. thanks!

reviews.title: Powerful prayers and scriptural declarations.
reviews.contents:
Essential birth prep for any Christian.

I have just birthed my fourth child, and is the third time I have used this app.
I used the positive affirmations and scriptures particularly frequently, and especially whenever I was going for a nap or a bath, and even as I had a pregnancy massage which helped me to associate the words (and voice of Tara!) with deep rest.
I was unsure in my first pregnancy, because of the term ‘hypnobirthing’ but would encourage anyone who has doubts because of this term, to dig a little deeper. Even if you don’t use the positive affirmations or prayers, having the scriptures read over you is so powerful!

It even inspired me to have my friends record some prayers, affirmations and scriptures for me. This must have been a God-idea because hilariously, my subscription ran out halfway through my 2.5 hour labour, with my very overdue babe!

 I am continuing to use the free affirmations as we navigate post-partum and breastfeeding.

reviews.title: Beautifully calming
reviews.contents: This app has great audio content for calming nerves and worries through calling on God, Jesus and the Holy Spirit. It has been very helpful so far, I started listening at around 30 weeks, listening most nights before I go to sleep and when I wake up in the night to get back to sleep. I have also been reading the accompanying book for the last couple of weeks too. The sleep function is very useful in app. Only criticism is I wish there were more tracks! 🥰

reviews.title: Great app!
reviews.contents: Having done quite a few hypnobirthing courses I was missing the mention of Jesus and the inclusion of faith into the ‘teachings’. This app totally fills the gap and offers great tracks to listen to in preparation for birth. As well as positive birth stories to bring Hope and inspire a positive experience. It’s a shame not many Christians I know are open to this and there still seems to be a stigma around the world ‘hypnobirthing’. Thankfully we are made in God’s image; creative beings, with a creative mind that can take us places. I am hoping I can take some of the powerful Spirit-led tools from the app on the day of my baby’s birth. Tara who created the app is very friendly and responsive on email!

reviews.title: So grateful for this app
reviews.contents: Thank you so much for making this app. It was a game changer for me during my twin birth. Will all the stress going on around me, I was able to plug in and get in the zone. It also helped me through my more recent single birth. I found other hypnobirthing tracks helpful but they often included things which were jarring to me as a Christian. This was exactly the right thing for getting me through birth from a Christian perspective. God’s word is relevant and powerful. Have recommended to various friends.

reviews.title: Wonderful!
reviews.contents:
What a wonderful app. As a first time mum to be, all the horror stories of pregnancy and birth are always in the front of your mind.

This app is great. It keeps you calm and relaxed. I’m no longer worrying and really believe that I can do this. My supportive partner also listens to this at night with me and we love the relaxing music track. Something that I’m hoping to take into the delivery suite with us! 

Every other day I have a notification pop up too with a quote from the bible (something that I respect but don’t live my life by) and I find these really useful too! 

As I’ve just touched on, I believe in a higher being etc but I’m still not 100% where to place my faith; but even I find the prayer track wonderful to listen too. 

A great app and one that I’d recommend to all who are expecting.

reviews.title: Incredible
reviews.contents:
Incredible in every way. Cast aside your scepticism and give this a try. My birth was not pain free but it was beautiful and there were moments during labour where I felt no pain. 

As a first time Mum I was consumed with birth fear. This podcast along with reading books and listening to positive birth stories helped to combat my fear to the extent that I couldn’t wait to experience birthing my baby. 

If practised well, this thing works!

reviews.title: An alternative to Hypnobirthing course
reviews.contents: This was recommended to me by a friend who used it ahead of giving birth during the first lockdown. Now that we are in lockdown again, and my NHS provider is offering free Hypnobirthing course I was keen to adapt it to fit in with my Christian lifestyle. So gave it a go and it is so easy to use and helps me to relax. The affirmation cards are verses of scripture which to me is more beneficial to remember that God is right there with you every step of the way through pregnancy and birth and beyond!

reviews.title: Disappointed...
reviews.contents:
I was so excited when I discovered the app and bought it - despite costing more than I'd typically spend on an app. 
Initially I was quite happy with the app then after a few weeks of use the app it updated and I no longer had access to what I had paid for and was offered to subscribe for a monthly or annual fee to get access to what I had already purchased. 
To say I'm disappointed is an understatement. Not exactly a stress free tool.
